title: Activating SDFGI & Texture Streaming spams binding errors in 4.8 dev 6
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.8.dev6.official (with texture streaming switched on in project settings)
- Not reproducible in: v4.8.dev5.official

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6.mono - Linux Mint 22 (Wilma) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (2560x1440 @ 144.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti (nvidia; 580.173.02) - AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 46.16 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

With texture streaming enabled in project settings, if SDFGI is active in the world environment, the game and even the editor starts spamming the following errors whenever the camera moves:

```
E 0:00:13:267   uniform_set_create: All the shader bindings for the given set must be covered by the uniforms provided. Binding (38), set (1) was not provided.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "uniform_idx == -1" is true. Returning: RID()
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:4512 @ uniform_set_create()
E 0:00:13:267   _allocate_from_uniforms: Condition "rid.is_null()" is true. Returning: rid
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/uniform_set_cache_rd.h:119 @ _allocate_from_uniforms()
E 0:00:13:267   draw_list_bind_uniform_set: Parameter "uniform_set" is null.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5916 @ draw_list_bind_uniform_set()

E 0:00:13:267   draw_list_draw: Uniforms were never supplied for set (1) at the time of drawing, which are required by the pipeline.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6162 @ draw_list_draw()
E 0:00:13:267   draw_list_draw: Uniforms were never supplied for set (1) at the time of drawing, which are required by the pipeline.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6162 @ draw_list_draw()
E 0:00:13:267   draw_list_draw: Uniforms were never supplied for set (1) at the time of drawing, which are required by the pipeline.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6162 @ draw_list_draw()
E 0:00:13:267   draw_list_draw: Uniforms were never supplied for set (1) at the time of drawing, which are required by the pipeline.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6162 @ draw_list_draw()
```

Disabling SDFGI or texture streaming (any one) makes the errors stop.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create new project
2. Add Camera3D and maybe a mesh
3. Add WorldEnvironment > Environment > Enable SDFGI
4. Enable texture streaming in project settings
5. Move camera in editor to observe the error spam.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[g4.8_dev6_issue_sdfgi_texture_streaming.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32411376/g4.8_dev6_issue_sdfgi_texture_streaming.zip)

I have added scripted camera movement so the issue can be seen in game as well.
